required_noise_sources.modeled_readout.reason: The model defines assignment error at 0.01 times gamma, but mixes already-sampled frequencies/counts deterministically. required_noise_sources.modeled_thermal_r.reason: Gate-duration-dependent relaxation/dephasing is implemented with T1=T2=100 microseconds divided by gamma. No executed thermal-noise records are supplied.
